messages:
Harper Lee: ZenithCare procurement sent a vendor questionnaire during onboarding. Asks: SOC2 evidence, can we sign their DPA or will we counter, list of subprocessors, support for customer-managed keys, and whether we can do field-level tokenization for PHI. PO is tentatively approved but withheld until answers. Need reply by Wed COB.

Nina Sethi: I can draft a short procurement-friendly reply. Marco, want to own sending?

Marco Alvarez: Yea I can send. Priya, legal-approved lines for DPA & SOC2?

Priya Nair: Keep it short: we execute our standard DPA for enterprise deals. We will review customer DPAs subject to legal approval and may require an enterprise amendment. SOC2: we provide a redacted SOC2 Type II attestation and bridge letter under NDA. Do not attach full report in channel.

Harper Lee: Good. Also they asked about subprocessors and EU data transfers.

Marco Alvarez: Subprocessors (high level): cloud infra, object storage, CDN, monitoring, identity provider. We'll attach current subprocessor csv via secure link under NDA. For EU transfers: we use SCCs for Hosted; Dedicated/Private can be region-locked.

Priya Nair: KMS line: Hosted default is provider-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private support CMK/HSM. We can offer CMK to Hosted customers as an enterprise feature but do not commit to immediate timelines.

Nina Sethi: Tokenization for PHI  product team note?

Marco Alvarez: I asked product. Short answer: we support application-level tokenization and token vaulting patterns. For strict field-level PCI/PHI tokenization we recommend Private deployment with customer HSM and a tokenization proxy.

Harper Lee: Nice. Can we offer a short deletion/export timeline? They asked for automated deletion after X days.

Priya Nair: Deletion policy: Hosted deletion workflows start within 7 business days; artifacts purged per retention schedule. Automated export-and-delete is an enterprise feature. Add legal caveat about holds for investigations.

OnboardBot: Task created: "Reply to ZenithCare vendor questionnaire + upload NDA assets" assigned to Marco Alvarez, due 2026-03-10.

Marco Alvarez: Drafting reply now  will paste Priya's lines, subprocessors summary, KMS wording, tokenization note, and ask them to sign NDA for SOC2/pen test. Tagging @Priya for DPA sign-off before send.

LegalBot: Reminder: do not promise >12 months Hosted log retention without Security approval.

Marco Alvarez: Sent reply at 1988882335 with secure link request for NDA. Included renewal note: if PO delayed >10 business days, escalate to AE for intervention.

Harper Lee: Thanks all 44d. Please paste ZenithCare response when it comes in so we can triage any redlines or extra evidence asks quickly.
